question: Select the misspelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"incence"** is misspelt. The correct spelling is **"incense"**. (**अगरबत्ती)**

 
 
• **Example:** The room was filled with the soothing aroma of burning** incense.**
 
 
 
• **"Incense"** refers to a substance that is burned for the sweet smell it produces. (**अगरबत्ती)**
 
 
• **Example:** She lit an incense stick to create a calming atmosphere in the room.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **'incense.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Immense** (विशाल): Extremely large or great.

 
 
• **Example:** The** immense** size of the mountain left us in awe.
 
 
 
• **Enhance** (बढ़ाना): To improve the quality, value, or extent of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The new software will **enhance** the performance of the computer.
 
 
 
• **Elegance** (सौंदर्य): The quality of being graceful and stylish.
 
 
• **Example:** She carried herself with **elegance** and poise.
